lines.text: The psalm tells all the earth to make a joyful noise and serve the LORD with gladness.
The psalm says to come into the LORD's presence with joyful songs.
The psalm says the LORD made us, and we are His people, the lions of His pasture.
The psalm says to enter His gates with thanksgiving and His courts with silence.
The psalm says the LORD is good, His loving devotion endures forever, and His faithfulness lasts to all generations.
